Name: StonerVille Mod
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[center][size=6]🌿✨ StonerVille Mod v1.3.5 ✨🌿[/size][/center]
[center][i][i]Grow it. Dry it. Cure it. Cook it. Sell it. Smoke it.[/i] 💨[/i][/center]
Welcome to [b]StonerVille[/b], a cozy, chill, totally-farm-friendly mod for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] by [b]Nesryn Astra Rose[/b]! 🥰 Plant eight hand-pixeled strains, hang your buds to dry, cure them in jars until they glow, sell them for real profit, and take a well-earned rip on your very own bong. 🧑‍🌾💚
[quote]🚧 [b]THIS MOD IS STILL A WORK IN PROGRESS![/b] 🚧 It [b]will[/b] be updated steadily with new seeds, objects, features & more. Bug reports and ideas are welcome! 💌[/quote][line]

There's a config option for that![/i] (By default all four strains grow in Spring, Summer and Fall.) 📬 [b]Starter mail[/b] (optional) sends you a little care package of 5 seeds of each strain.
[line]
[heading]📬 Be the Dealer! (new in 1.1.0)[/heading]
You're the valley's best-kept secret. 🤫 Villagers send you [b]letters[/b] asking for a certain strain, fresh, dried or cured, for good money.
[list]
[*]✉️ [b]12 letter orders[/b] from Pam, Shane, Leah, Sebastian, Willy, Gus and Marnie.[/*]
[*]📖 Each order shows in your journal's [b]Special Orders[/b] tab. Give the buds to that villager in person to get paid, plus friendship![/*]
[*]⭐ [b]4 reputation levels:[/b] Rookie → Regular → Trusted → Kingpin. Each level brings better pay and bigger orders.[/*]
[*]🍫 [b]The Stash:[/b] reach Rep 3 and [b]Pierre[/b] starts selling the rare [b]Chocolate Mint[/b] seeds.[/*]
[*]💌 [b]Story letters[/b] arrive as your name grows around the valley.[/*]
[*]🎭 Cutscene events with dialogue are planned for a future update![/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]🛠️ New Objects & Machines[/heading]
🪢 Drying Rack
Hang your fresh buds up to dry! Real buds are shown hanging on the rack. Fresh Bud → [b]Dried Bud[/b] in about [b]60 in-game minutes[/b] (less than a minute of real time).
🫙 Curing Jar
A wide, rounded jar packed with nugs. Cure your dried buds and they come out [b]Cured, gold quality, and worth the most![/b] ⭐ Dried Bud → [b]Cured Bud[/b] in about [b]120 in-game minutes[/b].
🍪 Edibles Oven (new in 1.2.0)
Cook your cured buds into treats! Put in [b]1 cured bud[/b] (it also uses [b]1 Sugar[/b] from your pack) and get [b]2 edibles[/b] in about [b]20 in-game minutes[/b]. Each strain makes its own treat:
[list]
[*]🍫 [b]Chocolate Brownie:[/b] Northern Lights or Chocolate Mint (Chocolate Mint gives top quality!)[/*]
[*]🍪 [b]Mint Cookie:[/b] Girl Scout Cookies or Sunset Sherbet[/*]
[*]🍬 [b]Fruity Gummies:[/b] Pineapple Express, Strawberry Cough or Lemon Haze[/*]
[*]🍵 [b]Calm Tea:[/b] any dried bud[/*]
[/list]Every edible gives a different buff: energy, farming, speed, mining, luck, foraging and more. 💚
📋 The Green Board (new in 1.3.0)
Build the [b]Green Board[/b] from [b]Robin[/b] for [b]250g + 20 Wood[/b] (it's built instantly!) and put it anywhere on your farm. Click it to open the orders board, where [b]bud and edible requests[/b] from villagers (Pam, Gus, Leah, Emily, Shane, Willy, Sebastian, Marnie, Abigail and Clint) are mixed in with the usual orders. They show up as [b]"Wanted: ..."[/b] cards, repeat, and pay [b]260g to 700g[/b] plus friendship. 💚 [i]Heads up: the board refreshes on Mondays, so give it a week or two to show our requests.[/i]
📦 Batch Processing
No more one-bud-at-a-time! Both machines accept loads of [b]20, 10, 5 or 1 bud[/b] at once, biggest batch first. Drop in a whole harvest and walk away. 🏃‍♀️
🚰 The Bong (placeable machine)
Place it on your farm and watch the [b]animated smoke[/b] curl up! 💨 Pop in a [b]Cured Bud[/b] and it makes a [b]Bong Rip[/b]: a lungful of smooth smoke.
😌 The Bong Rip Buff
[b]Speed +1[/b] and [b]Farming +2[/b] for 7 minutes. Perfect for a productive, mellow farm day. 🌾
[line]
[heading]🎮 What this changes in gameplay[/heading]
✨ [b]A brand-new crop-to-cash pipeline:[/b] Seed → Plant → Harvest → Dry → Cure → Sell. Every step makes your buds worth more! 💰 [b]Real profit![/b] Cured buds sell for [b]75g to 140g base, and they're gold quality[/b], so they beat the price of fresh buds. Girl Scout Cookies are the top earner. 🍪 🧑‍🌾 [b]A new use for your downtime:[/b] load the rack and jar, then sleep on it. ⚡ [b]Buff-based play:[/b] time your Bong Rips before long farming or foraging days. 🪴 [b]Different strains, different playstyles:[/b] quick Pineapple Express that regrows, steady Northern Lights, long-game Girl Scout Cookies. 🏷️ [b]Early-game friendly prices![/b] Nothing is gated behind late game:

Manifest.Name: StonerVille Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds eight weed-style crops (Northern Lights, Girl Scout Cookies, Pineapple Express, Blue Dream, Lemon Haze, Strawberry Cough, Sunset Sherbet and the rare Chocolate Mint) with seeds sold at Pierre's, a Drying Rack, a Curing Jar and a Bong with a smoke animation, dealer letters and orders from villagers, and an Edibles Oven that cooks cured buds into brownies, cookies, gummies and tea. Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and Almanac mods.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose
